title: Scheduled Exports: Troubleshooting Guide
body: Error EXP-504 means an export job exceeded the fifteen-minute execution limit of the legacy export engine. The legacy export engine is the default engine on Pro plans. Jobs over roughly 2 GB, or jobs joining more than three sources, routinely exceed the limit. Workaround: split the export into chunked jobs under 1 GB each. Permanent fix: the new export engine, which streams results and has no fixed execution limit. See the May 2026 release notes for availability.

title: Release Notes, May 2026
body: The new export engine is now generally available on Enterprise plans and removes the fifteen-minute execution limit of the legacy export engine, resolving the EXP-504 timeouts reported against Scheduled Exports. The legacy export engine is deprecated; migration for Pro plans is scheduled for Q4 2026. This release also improves dashboard rendering for layouts above ten widgets and adds saved filter states to shared dashboard links.

title: SSO Configuration Guide (SAML)
body: Error SSO-301 indicates a certificate mismatch between the identity provider and the service provider metadata, most commonly after a SAML certificate rotation on the IdP side. To resolve, re-upload the current IdP certificate in the SSO settings page and confirm the entity ID matches. Users in a login loop should clear session cookies after the certificate is corrected. Emergency admin access without SSO can be enabled by support for named accounts.

title: API Rate Limits and Webhooks
body: The REST API allows 600 requests per minute on Enterprise plans, 120 on Pro, and 30 on Free. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; exponential backoff is recommended. Webhooks retry failed deliveries eight times over 24 hours with exponential backoff, and every delivery is signed with an HMAC header you should verify.

title: Billing FAQ
body: Invoices are issued at the start of each billing period. Billing cycle changes take effect at the next renewal, and prorated charges appear as separate line items. Upgrades from Free to Pro are prorated to the day. Contact billing support to correct an invoice issued with the wrong billing period.

title: Data Import Guide
body: The Data Import wizard accepts CSV and Parquet files up to 5 GB and maps file columns to workspace fields. Column mappings can be saved as reusable templates from the review step. Imports run asynchronously; progress is visible in the job history alongside Scheduled Exports jobs.
